stock.description: Operating within Mainland China, Wanka Online Inc. delivers content distribution solutions tailored for the Android ecosystem. A core offering is its exclusive DAPG Platform, a proprietary system empowering marketers to disseminate diverse content, such as advertisements, interactive games, and streaming videos. The company additionally provides services in mobile ad placement, digital video distribution, and collaborative game publishing. Its clientele primarily comprises marketers from sectors like mobile advertising, game development and publishing, and the wider digital entertainment industry. Founded in 2014, Wanka Online Inc. maintains its headquarters in Beijing, People's Republic of China.
